description: Preview the cost, FX rate, and final amount for moving money between two currencies. Provide exactly one of `amountIn` (what the user sends) or `amountOut` (what they want to receive). Returns the quote ID, exchange rate, fee, and how long the quote stays valid. Use this BEFORE initiate_payment so the user can confirm the rate. Routes internally based on the currency pair — agents don't need to know which provider handles which corridor.

amountIn.description: Amount to send (in `fromCurrency` units). Omit if specifying `amountOut`.

amountOut.description: Amount to receive (in `toCurrency` units). Omit if specifying `amountIn`.

fromCurrency.description: Source currency. ONRAMP example: 'BRL' (sending Brazilian reais). OFFRAMP example: 'USDC' (sending Base USDC).

toCurrency.description: Destination currency. ONRAMP example: 'USDC'. OFFRAMP example: 'BRL'.

name: get_payment_quote
